title: Geometry
description: The parts layouts, prefabs and pieces are built of: boxes of cells half a metre on a side, laid one after another. Shared by layouts.schema.json, prefabs.schema.json and pieces.schema.json.

box.description: A box from one corner to the other: every cell whose middle is inside it is filled. A later part replaces what an earlier one filled.

type.description: Which kind of part this is.

min.description: Its corner with the smallest x, y and z, in metres, on the half-metre grid.

max.description: Its corner with the largest x, y and z, in metres, on the half-metre grid.

m.description: What it's made of: a material's id (data/materials.json).

about.description: What it is and what it's for, for people and agents: one or two sentences.

mirror.description: Also lay mirror images of it across the middle of what it's in: x (across x = 0: east and west), z (across z = 0: north and south), xz (all four quarters), point (both halves, each the other turned round the middle). Maps are fair from every side this way.

repeat.description: Lay it again in a row: count copies in all, each step further on.

count.description: How many copies, the first included.

step.description: How far on each copy is from the one before: [x, y, z] in metres (quarter metres; boxes stay on the half-metre grid).

block.description: A block: centred on at's x and z, from at's y up. The commonest part: walls, floors, platforms, boxes.

type.description: Which kind of part this is.

at.description: Where it stands: [x, y, z] in metres. x runs west to east, z north to south, y up; the floor is at y = 0, the arena spans -36 to 36 on x and z. On the grid: x and z in quarter metres, y in half metres.

size.description: How big: [width along x, height along y, depth along z], in metres: whole cells, so multiples of 0.5.
